narrative:
Auglaize County has 31,888 registered voters, with 14.2% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 40.3% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 43.2%, a modest Democratic lean of 2.9 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 29.5% of registrants.
